local_settings.title: Settings
local_settings.subtitle: Personalize your workspace and manage local data.
local_settings.appearance_desc: Choose how the app looks and reads.
local_settings.local_data_desc: Review where app data is stored on this device.
local_settings.background_tasks_desc: Choose how often account quotas refresh.
local_settings.auto_refresh_desc: Periodically fetches 5-hour and weekly quotas in the background so your balances are up to date when you open the app.
local_settings.advanced_options: Advanced options (Antigravity path, local folder, proxy)
local_settings.auto_sync: Sync the official app's current account
local_settings.auto_sync_desc: Keep the recorded account aligned with the official Antigravity app in the background.
local_settings.data_directory_desc: Stores account profiles, credentials and quota caches on this device only.
local_settings.application_paths_desc: Used to close, update credentials and relaunch Antigravity when switching accounts.
local_settings.app_desc: For seamless desktop app account and session switching

accounts.title: My accounts
accounts.subtitle: Click "Switch to this account" to close and relaunch Antigravity on that profile.
accounts.no_quota_yet: Quotas not loaded yet — click Refresh
accounts.unknown_hint: Plan information is unavailable. Refresh quota to retry.
accounts.disabled_tooltip: Account disabled: sign-in expired or revoked. Sign in again to restore it.
accounts.quota_window_5h: Show five-hour quota and reset times.

oauth.desc: Opens default browser for Google login to auto-fetch and save Token.
oauth.manual_hint: Browser didn't redirect? Paste the full callback URL or raw Code here:
oauth.web_hint: Google login page will open in a new window
oauth.manual_submitted: Authorization code submitted. Backend is processing...

token.label: Refresh Token
token.placeholder:
Paste your Refresh Token here (Batch supported)

Supported formats:
1. Single Token (1//...)
2. JSON Array (with refresh_token field)
3. Any text containing tokens (Auto-extraction)
token.hint: Accepts refresh tokens, JSON arrays or account export files. Export files contain login credentials; keep them private.

import.scan_desc: Reads the accounts already signed in to the system keychain, Antigravity IDE, plugins and CLI, then imports them.
import.file_title: Import an account export or database file
import.file_desc: Choose a Switch JSON export or an Antigravity state.vscdb file. Partial import results stay open for review.
import.failure_hint: Check login state, database locations and the system proxy for failed sources. Sign in again if credentials have expired.
import.status_validation_failed: Credential validation failed (network or expired login)

table.sort_by_reset_time: Click to sort by quota reset time
table.sort_by_last_used: Click to sort by last used time

accounts.drag_disabled_during_sort: Column sorting is active; drag-to-reorder is paused

empty.title: No Accounts
empty.desc: Click the "Add Account" button above to add your first account

model_display.title: Model Quota Display
model_display.description: Customize which model quotas are displayed.
model_display.mode_pinned_desc: Only display selected models on cards for a clean, focused view
model_display.mode_all_desc: Display all models available in the account
model_display.reset_default_title: Reset to the 3 recommended core models
model_display.availability_hint: Selecting a model does not grant access. Argon uses its own weekly quota.

settings_sections.general_description: Manage theme appearance, language, system startup, and local environment paths.
settings_sections.quota_description: Customize displayed models and background refresh frequency.
settings_sections.appearance_and_language_desc: Customize theme appearance and interface language.
settings_sections.storage_and_executables_desc: Manage local credentials directory and linked client application paths.

network.manual_hint: Supports http://, https://, socks5:// and socks5h:// without embedded credentials.
network.invalid_address: Enter a valid HTTP or SOCKS proxy address without credentials.
network.save_failed: Could not save. Check the proxy address and permissions.
